summary: Iteration 27 — F5 sentinel reset endpoint + DataIntegrityTile (Admin Observability Bundle final items). Backend: 13/13 tests pass (10 new live-API tests in test_f5_sentinel_reset_live.py + 3 pre-existing direct-coroutine tests). Verified POST /api/admin/migrations/f5-leads-backfill/reset shape, idempotency, audit_events row (actor_user_id matches /auth/me id, non-empty tenant_id, timestamp, sentinel_key, deleted_count=1 with seeded sentinel), role gate (admin/technician/customer -> 403 'Super admin access required', anonymous -> 403/401) and F9 GET /api/admin/data-repair/status regression shape. Frontend: super_admin login -> aquaterra workspace -> Dashboard tile renders with pill data-state='attention' (live dangling_refs_total=1, matches backend), 4-cell summary + last dry-run + last repair-run rows. /admin/migrations shows the tile ABOVE the P19 card (verified via bounding-rect ordering); all 5 legacy migration cards still render. Dialog opens with cancel+confirm; Cancel closes with 0 network calls; Confirm fires exactly 1 POST, shows sonner toast 'No F5 sentinel was present. Already re-armed.', closes the dialog and re-fetches status. Non-super_admin (admin@aquaterra.com): tile absent on Dashboard and /admin/migrations redirects to / (SuperAdminOnly guard holds).

previous_state is projected with {_id: 0} so no ObjectId leaks into the JSON response — verified by test_no_mongo_object_id_leak.
